articles.title: Crypto tech provider Haruko hit by cyberattack affecting 15 clients, some funds lost
articles.snippet: Some smaller hedge funds with weaker security controls may have lost funds in the targeted attack, sources said.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin climbs over $80,000 as crypto shakes off Clarity failure and higher interest rates
articles.snippet: Another central bank hiked rates overnight, this time the Bank of Japan. The move failed to halt the slide in the yen.

articles.title: REX launches 2x leveraged ETF tied to Bitcoin treasury firm Strive
articles.snippet: The new ASSX fund offers 2x daily exposure to Strive shares, giving traders a leveraged way to bet on the Bitcoin treasury company.

articles.title: Bastion wins conditional OCC approval for national trust bank charter
articles.snippet: Bastion Platforms National Trust Company will offer stablecoin custody and wallets, payment infrastructure and white-label issuance from a single federally regulated entity.

articles.title: Hong Kong jails ex-banker over $1.6B false credit, cryptocurrency bribes: Report
articles.snippet: Former banking official gets four years in prison over false letters of credit and accepting $470,000 in cryptocurrency bribes.
